workflow_runs.name: kc-dev-flow release gate
workflow_runs.display_title: feat(kc-dev-flow-2): a delivery gate question may carry the merge of the validated head

head_commit.message:
fix(kc-dev-flow-2): a carried merge is bound to the full head the delivery check passed

The Delivery authority sentence now says the merge runs with --match-head-commit set to that head, so a push after the check cannot land an unvalidated head. Net zero README words: the offsetting cuts are 'under that grant', 'to finish' and 'FO confirms'.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
